title: POS Pulse Live Terminal Map
summary: Repo-backed topology for the secure Windows POS terminal.

nodes.label: Cashier/operator
nodes.description: Named operator using the terminal to scan, tender, finalize, print, and recover sale work.

nodes.label: React renderer
nodes.description: Touch-first POS UI, routes, visual system, and operator-facing workflow surfaces.

nodes.label: Typed preload bridge
nodes.description: Typed contextBridge boundary. Renderer never reaches Node or Electron APIs directly.

nodes.label: Electron main
nodes.description: High-trust process for SQLite, safeStorage, audit, pairing, session, printing, and IPC handlers.

nodes.label: SQLite state
nodes.description: Versioned local terminal state and migration runner for offline-aware POS operation.

nodes.label: safeStorage
nodes.description: Electron safeStorage protects terminal secrets through the Windows DPAPI-backed boundary.

nodes.label: SmartDataPulse API
nodes.description: External SaaS backend contract consumed through generated types and pinned snapshots.

nodes.label: POS hardware
nodes.description: Windows x64 terminal hardware: scanner, receipt printer, and optional cash drawer.

nodes.label: Vitest gates
nodes.description: Vitest, Testing Library, axe-core, and process-boundary tests protect terminal behavior.

nodes.label: 008 receipts
nodes.description: Active sale finalization and receipts feature. Implementation is blocked pending review and gates.

nodes.label: Constitution
nodes.description: Binding rules for money, Electron isolation, IPC, hardware, identity, logging, and quality gates.
